title: One masked man robbed 17 stagecoaches in Yellowstone #Shorts
description:
August 24, 1908. A single masked man stopped stagecoach after stagecoach near Kepler Cascades. By the most-cited count he robbed seventeen of them and was never caught.

▶ Full documentary (Part 2, When the Cavalry Guarded the Geysers): https://youtu.be/P99Gu3GCZVw

#Shorts #Yellowstone #NationalParks #History
